scenario: Product within 5°F of its limit while loading (marginal)
resolution_steps: Product is near its limit — not yet critical
Stop loading this product and return the pallet to its cold room, not the open dock
Check the trailer: reefer running, set to the load's set-point, and pre-cooled
Re-probe the CENTER of a case in 10 minutes (edge cases warm faster)
If the reading is back within the limit: continue loading and keep door-open time short
If it is still over the limit: do not load it — escalate to your supervisor
Log both readings on the report
source_reference: Cold Chain SOP 2.2 — Outbound Marginal Temperature

scenario: Product more than 5°F above its limit while loading
resolution_steps: CRITICAL — do not load this product
Return the pallet to its cold room now and place it on quality hold

Do not seal or release the trailer with this product on it
Supervisor and Quality Manager are being notified automatically

resolution_steps: Recount the cases staged for the line against the pick list
